scientific_integrity: Both sharp constants follow from a complete analytic proof using symmetry averaging and graph heat kernels; the included exact rational finite checker is supplementary and does not prove unbounded parameter coverage. No independent expert validation or audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: All integer d>=2,q>=3, unit-edge Hamming graphs and real edge-l1 relative projections only. No claim for unequal factor sizes, arbitrary weights, or uniqueness of every minimizer. The known binary specialization and prior symmetry uniqueness are excluded from the novelty claim. Historical priority under alternative terminology is not exhaustively settled.
title: Sharp cycle and cut projection constants for nonbinary Hamming graphs
